column1: # SAF loop lever taxonomy (Addendum A7 + plan 205 Movement 2). TAB-separated: id <TAB> mode <TAB> family <TAB> scope <TAB> description
# ROI order top-to-bottom, mechanism-derived (reach-mechanisms.md §6 + conc-term-mechanisms.md §5). Lever
# SELECTION round-robins across FAMILIES so every property type gets coverage; WITHIN a family the highest
# earned gen_credit (holdout-boosts, plan 205 §2.5) is picked first, ties broken by THIS file's order (ROI).
# Families appear in ROI order: termination (highest single-move ROI, no witness/-16/-32 risk) → unreach-call
# (the big capability push incl. ConcurrencySafety-FALSE, which scores in unreach-call) → valid-memsafety /
# no-overflow (bank honest pool points) → no-data-race (LAST, smallest pool). mode ∈ {tuning, capability}.
#     local    — change confined to ONE property's confirmer/verdict path; eval'd on that family only.
#     crosscut — touches SHARED infra (frontend / PTA / AIR / slicing / sequentialization) that runs for
#                EVERY property; eval'd on ALL properties, REVERTED if any family regressed.
# Every FALSE-emitting lever MUST obey scripts/loop/confirmer_contract.md (fail-closed rules R1–R7).
# Shared infra built once and reused by bmc-fixed-k/se-interp/bmc-incremental/fuzz-concolic-z3: an
# AIR→SSA path/program encoder + nondet-model extractor (see reach-mechanisms.md §6 "Shared infrastructure").
# Prefix a line with # to PARK it. The supervisor skips parked/commented levers.
# The rank-1 'build robustness' marks-loss fix was DEPLOYED DIRECTLY on 2026-08-21 (commit 3c47ac2d), NOT an
#   arm. Real diagnosis (roadmap misdiagnosed it): ingestion already neutralizes the __VERIFIER_assert do/while
#   macro collision, but the unreach native-replay confirmers (fuzz_confirm_false + replay_confirms_false) did
#   NOT -> ~931 arithmetic-cluster FALSE never ran. Fix = reuse the neutralizer there + -fsanitize-trap=signed-
#   integer-overflow so overflow-only reaches abstain (else array-fpi/indp2 signed-overflow UB = -16 FP).
#   Validated real-scorer FP=0 / zero regression / ~+98 raw FALSE recovered.

column5: Raise termination-TRUE recall via LINEAR RANKING-FUNCTION synthesis (Podelski–Rybalchenko / Farkas+Motzkin+Z3) for single natural loops: extract the loop from the CFG (back-edge/dominator), build the linear transition relation LOOP(x,x') from AIR, template f=s0+sum(s_i*x_i), require LOOP=>f>=0 and LOOP=>f-f'>=1, eliminate the forall via Motzkin, discharge the exists with Z3 (qe/nlsat), extract coeffs. TRUE iff (loop-free AND acyclic) OR (every natural loop ranked AND acyclic callgraph). A valid ranking function is a COMPLETE proof — no soundness risk; TRUE needs no witness (+2 on the verdict). PRESERVE plan-201 hardening (abstain on llvm.global_ctors/dtors + any reachable block with no terminator). Follow-ons: lexicographic/multiphase (k=2), SCC-decomposition per-loop.

Scalar-promote provably non-escaped fixed-size scalar allocas to SSA phis BEFORE ranking, so -O0-spilled loop counters (*i) and recursion params become affine state the existing ranking.rs pipeline can rank. ENABLING lever: today ranking.rs treats Load as opaque, so the whole recursion reservoir (recursive-simple/recursive/recursified_*) + memory-alloca loops capture 0. Fail-closed escape gate (promote only when the alloca is used EXCLUSIVELY as a Load/Store operand, never fed to Gep/Call/store-as-value); abstain on any doubt. TRUE-only, no witness (+2), preserves plan-201 hardening. Mandatory negative test: an address-escaped slot must NOT promote.

Disjunctive path-split of != / ==-else guards into two convex half-spaces (BOTH must rank) to recover rankable recursions whose lower bound is currently dropped as non-convex. FOLLOW-ON of term-mem2reg-counters (guard operands are opaque Loads until promoted; captures nothing before it). Unconditionally sound (a superset of each real transition; Sat-only Farkas, failure abstains). Negative test: while(x!=5)x+=2 from an even start must abstain.

THE biggest missing lever (self-confirming, a wrong FALSE is impossible). Link a deterministic byte-stream shim for __VERIFIER_nondet_* (each call consumes sizeof(T) bytes; ranges bounded by interval-AI; dictionary = IR constants), compile reach_error=>abort, run an AFL-style blind mutation loop under SAF's existing native-replay harness; an abort IS a confirmed FALSE + witness (no separate confirm step). Obey confirmer_contract R1/R3/R4/R5/R6. Directly attacks the 0% novel-recall floor.

Backward AIR program slice from every reach_error criterion via a PDG (use+data+control deps; PTA-annotated may/must sets; NTSCD). ADD __VERIFIER_assume as a SECONDARY slicing criterion (else range guards are sliced away => spurious inputs, R4). Emit executable sliced AIR + coarse abort-prune; ALWAYS confirm on the ORIGINAL unsliced program (a slice can drop a constraint the real program enforces). Scalability multiplier for every solve/fuzz lever. Touches shared AIR/analysis => all-property gated.

Turn fuzz-mut-nondet into a deep-target engine: compile with SanitizerCoverage (inline-8bit-counters,pc-table,trace-cmp); build an 8-bit coverage map + new-coverage seed-keeping + AFLFast energy; optionally AFLGo distance-to-reach_error annealing; pc-table feeds YAML-2.0 witness waypoints. Same self-confirming native-replay oracle (a crash = confirmed FALSE).

(ex-symbolic-oracle, built out) Unwind AIR loops to bound k (callees inlined to depth d), encode guarded SSA + reach_error reachability to Z3 (nondet = fresh bitvectors of width(T)), on SAT read the model in nondet-call order => input vector => native-replay confirm (replay decides; a wrong model => replay fails => abstain). The k-induction BASE CASE only; NO forward-condition/inductive-step. Builds the shared AIR→SSA encoder + nondet-model extractor reused by se-interp/bmc-incremental/fuzz-concolic-z3. COST-GATE (MANDATORY; DETERMINISTIC — the verdict MUST be reproducible across machines/load, so NEVER gate on elapsed wall-clock): run the Z3/BMC pass LAST (after guard-enum + interproc + blind-fuzz) and ONLY when they returned no confirmation, behind a CHEAP STRUCTURAL pre-filter (loops present AND bounded bitvector/integer width AND references nondet; SKIP nonlinear-arith/float where Z3 stalls — that is the arm-84 nla ps6-ll 1.6s→60s TIMEOUT that reverted a real hardware-verification-bv solve). Bound cost by the fixed k/unwind/width parameters, never by a timer. Goal: keep the arm-84 btor2c solve WITHOUT timing fast tasks out.

ConcurrencySafety-FALSE FINDER (Lazy-CSeq bLMP) — REPLACES the blind conc-shim sweep. AIR→AIR lazy round-robin sequentialization (pc-labeled re-enterable thread fns + static per-thread local cells + round-robin driver) where run-length rl[i][r] is a genuine nondeterministic choice the SOLVER assigns; yields fire ONLY at PTA-shared accesses + sync/create/join; encode to Z3 (loops unwound U), SAT => read the rl matrix as an explicit schedule. Under-approx => tightening K/U/L costs recall not soundness. Fail-closed: SC-only, abstain on pthread-wmm/C11-relaxed/dropped #pragma omp; reachability-gate dead pthread_create scaffolding. AIR→AIR pass => all-property gated.

ConcurrencySafety confirmer: decode conc-seq-m1's rl schedule to a (threadId,steps) vector; a pthread interposer (intercept create/join/mutex/cond, gate each op on a shared turn-counter) forces THAT exact interleaving on the ORIGINAL unmodified binary under ASan/UBSan. Mis-modeling can only cost recall (replay fails => abstain), never a wrong FALSE. Abstain on any divergence between replay and the recorded schedule.

Cheap PTA-filtered CHESS first-pass: preemption-bounded sweep (c<=1 -> c<=2) with yields ONLY at PTA-shared accesses, ASan/UBSan on; also the replay substrate for conc-replay-confirm. NOT a standalone scorer (data-blind) => keep behind conc-seq-m1. Metric: FALSE recall at FA=0.

GraphML-1.0 concurrency-witness emitter from the confirmed schedule (threadId per error-path CFA transition + createThread edges + enterFunction/returnFromFunction + startline). Target ConcurrentWitness2Test (execution-based, best SAF fit) / Dartagnan / CPAchecker-Validator-4.0. YAML 2.0 scores 0 for concurrency (R7) — without this every concurrency FALSE is +0 not +1. Verify >=1 concurrency validator is active in the target year.

KLEE-style bounded forward symbolic interpreter over SLICED AIR (fork on Z3-feasible branches, per-object symbolic arrays, constraint-independence + counterexample cache); solve the path condition at reach_error for a model => native-replay confirm. Complements bmc-fixed-k on branchy control-flow. Reuses the shared SSA encoder.

Grow bmc-fixed-k's unwinding bound in ONE persistent Z3 context, gating each depth's reach_error check with a check-sat-assuming activation literal, until SAT or k_max. ~10x deeper reach per budget vs fixed-k. Same native-replay confirm gate.

On a coverage plateau (Driller stuck-detector), symbolically execute a stuck seed's path over the AIR, Z3-solve the negation of an uncovered branch (constraint-slicing + optimistic fallback — safe because replay gates), feed the solved input back as a fuzz seed; CmpLog/laf-intel handle cheap magic-number cases first. Needs fuzz-covguided + the bmc encoder.

Entry-point/harness synthesis + complex-object havocking (KLEE symbolic-memory + FuzzedDataProvider for aggregates) so nondet structs/pointers/arrays become symbolic/fuzzable inputs. STRUCTURAL (not nondet-solving) — the binding constraint on the 2026 Intel-TDX firmware batch; unblocks fuzz/bmc/se on it. Touches shared frontend/harness => all-property gated.
Frontend robustness on anonymous unions / nested types — prevents quiet wrong answers and unlocks TDX-family reachability. Frontend change => all-property gated.

Extract cheap AIR Booleans (loop/array/float/recursion/nonlinear/narrow-range/branch-x-nondet) and route each task to a ranked sequence of levers (fuzz L1-2 / BMC L4 / SE L5) under a time budget with early abstention; later learn the ranking from solved-by labels. Build after >=2 solve/fuzz levers exist.

Wire an execution-based validator (cpa-witness2test-style) into SAF's confirmation gate: accept CONFIRM if analysis OR execution replay agrees. Validator-side, no witness-content change (measured 3/7 -> 6/7). Confirm ONLY on the matching ASan memory error (R1).

Coverage-guided greybox recall over the SAME ASan harness: PORT the existing (parked) fuzz.rs byte-stream shim/mutator (XorShift64-deterministic, assume-as-hard-reject) as a pass-3 in the ASan confirmer; an ASan trap parsed by the UNMODIFIED R1/R2 parse_asan_report gate IS the confirmed FALSE. Targets the ~25 asan-no-fire clusters (uthash/array/list/busybox first); ldv-driver subset blocked on harness-havoc. Self-confirming, fail-closed, R1/R3/R4 preserved. Do NOT rebuild the mutation loop. COST-GATE (MANDATORY; DETERMINISTIC — never gate on elapsed wall-clock): run pass-3 fuzz LAST and ONLY when pass-1/pass-2 are inconclusive, behind the existing cheap structural gate (>=2 scalar nondet sites AND a heap/OOB surface present). Bound by a FIXED trial/iteration count (deterministic, same seed => same result), and do NOT double-compile — the SanitizerCoverage recompile is what drove the arm-81 -233 by timing other tasks out. Reuse pass-1/2's already-built binary.

Raise no-overflow FALSE recall via the UBSan signed-overflow confirmer (R6, plan 199): widen the loop-free / interval reachability that feeds the confirmer and close the 64-bit gap; every FALSE concretely UBSan-replayed (no FALSE without a confirmed trap). Narrow the oracle to -fsanitize=signed-integer-overflow ONLY — ignore conversion/shift/pointer traps (R2). Big pool (~9060 train tasks).

column5: COMPLETE must-not-race TRUE prover mirroring termination.rs discipline: emit true(no-data-race) ONLY under P1 (consistent non-empty must-lockset for ALL conflicting pairs) OR P3 (cross-thread-shared locations read-only after the spawn HB point). Require a COMPLETE call graph; abstain on ANY reachable indirect call / un-modeled sync / relaxed-mem / OpenMP. Do NOT reuse the may-finder no-candidate (unsound). Verdict-only +2, no witness (sidesteps the frozen YAML-2.0-only validator that zeroes every ndr FALSE). Mandatory scaled WRONG_TRUE=0 audit over all racy tasks as a hard KEEP condition. Keep analyze_no_data_race dead.

no-data-race FALSE FINDER (Eraser/Goblint lockset + MHP): ICFG dataflow with lockset domain 2^pts(mutex-arg) (lock adds pts(m), unlock removes); at each load/store record (instr,kind,lockset,tid); Andersen-PTA same-location may-alias pairs with EMPTY must-lockset intersection + >=1 write + may-happen-in-parallel => race candidate. Over-approx; CONFIRM is the soundness gate. Eraser virgin/exclusive/shared/shared-modified suppresses init-idiom FPs.

no-data-race SCHEDULE: for a candidate (a0@T0,a1@T1) stage a relaxed-atomic busy-wait rendezvous (C11 __ATOMIC_RELAXED spin, NOT pthread_barrier_wait which creates happens-before) just before each access so both fire concurrently with NO HB edge => TSan observes the unordered conflicting pair. Injected via LD_PRELOAD/instrumentation keyed to the FIND locations. The rendezvous IS the witness schedule.

no-data-race CONFIRM (TSan-style FastTrack HB): vector-clock epochs + shadow memory; race = same-location, >=1 write, not HB-ordered, not atomic. SAF's existing substrate — 0 ROI alone; needs race-find + race-schedule to target and stage the pair. Every FALSE gated on the detector firing. Smaller pool => LAST. Abstain on weak-memory/OpenMP/un-modeled sync (R7).

DEFERRED (R10, LAST per branch-sequencing): valid-memcleanup FALSE via a leak-at-exit confirmer. Parked — the split pool currently has ~0 memcleanup tasks; revisit only after the memsafety/overflow/unreach/termination levers are exhausted.
